title: Phase 0.4: every 0% and 100% claim says 'plus card processing'

source.ref: §14 Phase 0.4 (Fees): "plus card processing" beside every 0% and 100% claim; §4.2 hole 10, against docs/VALUE-LADDER.md §2 ("We never describe a rate as '0%' without the words 'plus card processing' nearby in the same view").

detail:
The pricing surfaces said "0%", "You keep 100%" and "no fee" with nothing about card processing, which Stripe always passes through. lib/pricing/plan-story.ts now carries two caveat fragments, PLAN_STORY.plusProcessing (after a rate) and PLAN_STORY.afterProcessing (after a kept share), and every 0% / 100% claim in /pricing, lib/pricing, the page-editor templates in this lane (pricing, spaces, how-to-build-community) and llms-full.txt reads one of them in the same sentence. The tips "no fee" lines say "no platform fee, only card processing", and PLAN_STORY.selling carries the same words. Copy only: no checkout, rate, or price changed. home, about, what-is-frequency and tools-for-community-builders belong to the other Phase 0 rows, as do lib/marketing/funnel-config.ts and comparisons.ts.

The probe parses every string in scope with the TypeScript parser, so a comment is never a claim, and fails any 0%, 100%, no-fee or keep-everything claim whose own sentence lacks "card processing" or a real PLAN_STORY caveat interpolation. A bare "0%" stat value is checked with its object's label. It plants claims first and proves it catches them.

Shipped 2026-10-13.
